title: Robot arm
description: A toy robot arm on a workbench. Tap a block and it picks it up, then tap the bench or another block to put it down or stack it. Leave it alone and it sorts the painted blocks into a tower per colour, then scatters a few and starts again. Its joints are solved with cyclic coordinate descent using wgpu-matrix, and a desk lamp lights the dim workshop with soft-edged shadows.
line: A toy robot arm stacking painted blocks by colour. Tap one to move it.
hint: tap a block, then tap where it goes · point to steer the arm · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
